statement_map.email_excerpt: You had connected your payment gateway, but your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they buy.
Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email for your product and saved it, and a test order you placed produced the confirmation email in your inbox.
The default sender name on the email can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.
Change the sender name to your brand name under Email settings, Sender name (you mentioned after the call).
